description: The chart illustrates the number of conversations categorized by whether deception occurred (“Deceived”: Yes, Partially, No) across four application contexts. The categories are shown on the vertical axis in the order (top to bottom) Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism, while the horizontal axis is a linear numeric scale labeled “Number of Conversations,” with tick marks shown at regular 10-unit intervals from 0 to 60 (and bars extending slightly beyond 60). For each category, three horizontally oriented bars are grouped together: a dark red bar for “Yes,” an olive/yellow bar for “Partially,” and a dark green bar for “No,” with no stacking. In Academic Collaboration, the “Yes” bar is about 36, “Partially” about 27, and “No” about 7; in Recruitment, “Yes” is about 38, “Partially” about 24, and “No” about 6; in Academic Funding, “Yes” is about 65, “Partially” about 4, and “No” about 3; and in Journalism, “Yes” is about 15, “Partially” about 48, and “No” about 6. The bars are not visually sorted by magnitude, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend titled “Deceived” in the upper-right.
